seo.title: Book a call
seo.description: Book a free 30-minute review with Altrazen. No preparation needed.

hero.heading: Thirty minutes, no preparation needed
hero.description: Pick a slot below. If none of them work, email us and we will find one that does.

expectations.heading: What happens on the call
items: You tell us what the product does, who depends on it, and what you are worried about.
We ask what you built it with, roughly how large it is, and where it is hosted.
We tell you whether an audit is worth buying. If the answer is no, we say that.
If it is worth it, you get a price and a start date before the call ends.

requirements.heading: What we'll ask for
items: Nothing in advance. No documents, no slides, no repository access.
Just be somewhere you can talk for half an hour.

fallback.description: If the scheduler does not load, or you block third-party scripts, open it directly or email us.
